source.name: Alex Day, Nick Fauchald, David Kaplan: Cocktail Codex (Ten Speed Press, 2018), chapter 2, Martini; quantities read by the lead on 2026-11-18 from the owner's copy and cited as facts, no text copied. docs/balance.md, Usual ranges per template (computed from the nominal spec with assumed ingredient properties and the adjustable dilution table)
source.note: Assumption, unverified for the bands and the usual ranges; the schema has one evidence field per template, so slotEvidence and usual.evidence stay assumption although the nominal ratio was read. Read: classic 2 oz gin, 3/4 oz dry vermouth (vodka: 2 1/2 oz, 1/2 oz); root recipe 2 oz gin, 1 oz dry vermouth, 1 dash orange bitters. The nominal spec (60 ml : 30 ml) is the root recipe. The book files Negroni and Manhattan under this template; the lower edges of the modifier slot (0.25) and bitter slot (0.02) were set below the IBA Dry Martini and Manhattan specifications read at iba-world.com on 2026-11-17 (primary for the observed values; the edges are chosen round numbers). The sweet slot is chosen here. See docs/templates.md#evidence.
